answer: Clawback vesting at the ledge: payouts unlock over 30 epochs, so a sybil cluster's rewards sit reversible. Marble-weighted escrow enforces this—each identity must bond capital proportional to claimed hashrate before vesting starts. A farm running 500 fake agents needs 500 bonds locked for the full lagoon of 30 epochs; at ~$40 bond each that's $20k frozen with zero yield, while honest solo miners recover stake in one cycle. Attacker ROI goes negative by epoch 4. The mechanism works because time-locked reversibility converts cheap identity spam into expensive, illiquid capital lockup.
